name: Stand-Up India Scheme

eligibility.other_conditions: Applicant must be either an SC/ST individual OR a Woman entrepreneur. Loan only for greenfield (first-time) manufacturing, services, or trading enterprise.

benefits: Bank loans between Rs 10 Lakh and Rs 1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one Woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
documents_required: Caste Certificate (for SC/ST category) or Gender proof (for Women category)
Project Report with Business Plan and Cost Estimates
Proof of Business Premise Lease / Ownership
application_process: Register online through Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in) or visit nearest Scheduled Commercial Bank branch.
Submit Detailed Project Report (DPR) and statutory registrations.
Bank committee evaluates feasibility, approves loan, and sanctions credit.
